title: Application of dual Nr4a1-GFP Nr4a3-Tocky reporter mice to study T cell receptor signaling
author: Jennings, Lecky, et al.
materials: Anti CD69 AF700 Armenian hamster monoclonal H1.2F3
Anti CD103 PE Armenian hamster monoclonal 2E7
Anti CX3CR1 BV605 mouse monoclonal SA011F11
Anti CD11c BV711 Armenian hamster monoclonal N418
Anti-TCRbeta PerCP-Cy5.5 Armenian hamster monoclonal H57-597
Applied Biosystems SYBR green power up master mix

steps.title: Prepare staining mix
steps.instruction: Make a staining solution in 2 % FBS PBS (v/v) containing the following dilutions: Viability Dye eFluor780 1:2000, CD4 BUV395 1:200, CD8 BUV737 1:200, CD69 AF700 1:50, and any optional PE‑Cy7, APC, PerCP‑Cy5.5, or DUMP antibodies as desired. Include single‑color compensation controls for GFP, Timer‑Blue, and Timer‑Red.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture plate at 500 × g for 3 min, then flick the plate to decant the supernatant and, while still inverted, blot the plate against a paper towel.

steps.title: Add staining mix to cells
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL of the prepared staining mix to each well containing the cell suspension in 2 % FBS PBS.

steps.title: Incubate staining reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 20 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash cells after staining
steps.instruction: Add 180 µL of wash buffer to each well, centrifuge at 500 × g for 3 min, flick to decant supernatant, and blot the inverted plate against a paper towel.

steps.title: Resuspend and transfer to FACS tube
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 150 µL 2 % FBS PBS and transfer to a 5 mL FACS tube (BD Biosciences). Add an additional 150 µL 2 % FBS PBS to the well, transfer this wash to the same tube, yielding a final volume of 300 µL.

steps.title: Keep samples cold and acquire
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on ice in the dark and acquire the samples on the flow cytometer within 2 h of staining. Analyze cells as soon as possible; prolonged storage at 4 °C (e.g., overnight) can cause slow maturation of the Timer‑Blue to Timer‑Red signal.

steps.title: Set fluorescence thresholds
steps.instruction: Use a non‑transgenic control mouse to define the positivity thresholds for Nr4a1‑GFP and Nr4a3‑Blue signals.

steps.title: Normalize fluorescence percentages
steps.instruction:
Normalize each sample’s fluorescence using the following formulas (T in minutes):
Nr4a1‑GFP Normalized = [(%Nr4a1‑GFP in condition − %Nr4a1‑GFP at T = 0) ÷ (%Nr4a1‑GFP at T = 240 − %Nr4a1‑GFP at T = 0)] × 100.
Nr4a3‑Blue Normalized = [(%Nr4a3‑Blue in condition − %Nr4a3‑Blue at T = 0) ÷ (%Nr4a3‑Blue at T = 240 − %Nr4a3‑Blue at T = 0)] × 100.
